export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'jamna-auto-industries-limited' shows "Total Shipments 4691 Records detected", "Trading Partners 27", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; row-level records read: "2026-02-28 | JAMNA AUTO INDUSTRIES LIMITED | TO ORDER | LEAF SPRINGS ASSEMBLY- | KAMARAJAR PORT INENR1, India | Gothenburg, SWEDEN | 73201011 | 1117103" and "2026-02-28 | JAMNA AUTO INDUSTRIES LIMITED | TO ORDER | LEAF SPRINGS ASSEMBLY- | KAMARAJAR PORT INENR1, India | Hamburg, GERMANY | 73201011 | 1142722". Top ports listed: KAMARAJAR PORT INENR1 342, Hamburg 304, KAMARAJAR PORT SEA 178, KAMARAJAR PORT 132, LONDON GATWAY PORT 87. Source counter: page claims 4691 total shipments; only 2 row-level export records were actually visible on the free view (plus 5 port aggregates).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs records (2026-02-28) with destination (Sweden, Germany), HS 73201011 (leaf springs / springs of iron or steel) and B/L numbers 1117103 and 1142722. Declared HS 732010 / 732020 is consistent with the observed 73201011; no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified in this run: web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection refused on every attempt, jamnaauto.com did not resolve (DNS error), screener.in and tickertape.in returned 404, moneycontrol returned 403, BSE page returned only a navigation shell with no financial content. Therefore GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report domestic/export splits are recorded as null — not public/not retrievable here, not invented. Note the company is a listed Indian leaf-spring maker (JAI) and the customs data shows it also appears as an importer/buyer (e.g. supplier 52 OWEN SPRINGS LTD, 76 NINGBO HYLEMAN HYDRAULIC), i.e. two-way trade, but that is trade data, not domestic-supply proof. No rejection grounds: legal entity exists and is active in customs records.
